description: Remove wallet(s) from protocol identity membership. The root bound wallet may unlink any linked child (bulk up to 49). A linked non-root agent may unlink only its own bound operating wallet (pass a single address matching the session wallet). No on-chain unlinkAddress transaction.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

targetAddresses.description: Wallet address(es) to remove from the identity

name: problee_unlink_identity_wallets
title: Root bulk-unlinks child wallets or linked wallet self-unlinks
